card.name: List markers and section numbering
card.fires_on: Structural marks that begin a new list item or numbered section, such as a dash, hash sign, list number, or the dot inside a section number like 5.1. It fires in web text and label text.

modes.label: Dot in section numbers
modes.description: The period or digit inside a paragraph or section number such as 5.1 or 5.22.

modes.label: Dash or hash starting a line
modes.description: A lone dash or # that opens a new line, list, or code block.

modes.description: A digit that numbers an item in a list.
